content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization or information deficiency; the balance cannot simply be shifted to the patient. Peer-to-peer review is offered, and no published rule prohibits another review after the earlier attempt. Although its success rate is low, it is the only rework action that paid similar claims (1/16 versus 0/3 for appeals), so another peer-to-peer review is preferable to an unsupported resubmission or premature write-off.","action":"request_peer_to_peer"}
